t: 艾哈迈德·沙阿·杜拉尼在巴拉里加特战役中击败了马拉塔斯人.
te: Ahmad Shah Durrani defeats the Marathas in the Battle of Barari Ghat.
dz: 艾哈迈德·沙阿·杜拉尼在巴拉里加特战役中击败了马拉塔斯人.
de: Ahmad Shah Durrani defeats the Marathas in the Battle of Barari Ghat.

t: 1760年波士顿大火摧毁了349所建筑.
te: The Great Boston Fire of 1760 destroys 349 buildings.
dz: 1760年波士顿大火摧毁了349所建筑.
de: The Great Boston Fire of 1760 destroys 349 buildings.

t: 法军开始围攻被英军占领的魁北克.
te: French forces commence the siege of Quebec which is held by the British.
dz: 法军开始围攻被英军占领的魁北克.
de: French forces commence the siege of Quebec which is held by the British.

t: 皇家海军抵达后,法军包围了魁北克撤退以解除英国驻军.
te: French forces besieging Quebec retreat after the Royal Navy arrives to relieve the British garrison.
dz: 皇家海军抵达后,法军包围了魁北克撤退以解除英国驻军.
de: French forces besieging Quebec retreat after the Royal Navy arrives to relieve the British garrison.

t: 从阿卡迪亚人手中取出的新英格兰种植园主来到加拿大新斯科舍要求土地.
te: New England planters arrive to claim land in Nova Scotia, Canada, taken from the Acadians.
dz: Great Upheaval:从阿卡迪亚人手中取出的新英格兰种植园主来到加拿大新斯科舍要求土地.
de: Great Upheaval: New England planters arrive to claim land in Nova Scotia, Canada, taken from the Acadians.

t: 罗伯特·罗杰斯和他的游骑兵惊奇地在尚普兰湖(Champlain)附近的里切利乌河上拥立了圣泰雷…
te: Robert Rogers and his Rangers surprise French held Fort Sainte Thérèse on the Richelieu River near Lake Champlain. The …
dz: 法印战争:罗伯特·罗杰斯和他的游骑兵惊奇地在尚普兰湖(Champlain)附近的里切利乌河上拥立了圣泰雷斯堡. 堡垒被突袭并被烧毁.
de: French and Indian War: Robert Rogers and his Rangers surprise French held Fort Sainte Thérèse on the Richelieu River near Lake Champlain. The fort is raided and burned.

t: 兰德舒特战役:奥地利击败普鲁士.
te: Battle of Landeshut: Austria defeats Prussia.
dz: 七年战争:兰德舒特战役:奥地利击败普鲁士.
de: Seven Years' War: Battle of Landeshut: Austria defeats Prussia.

t: 切罗基战士在今北卡罗莱纳奥托附近的回声战役中击败了英国军队.
te: Cherokee warriors defeat British forces at the Battle of Echoee near present-day Otto, North Carolina.
dz: 盎格鲁-谢罗基战争:切罗基战士在今北卡罗莱纳奥托附近的回声战役中击败了英国军队.
de: Anglo-Cherokee War: Cherokee warriors defeat British forces at the Battle of Echoee near present-day Otto, North Carolina.

t: 英国军队在最后一场新法兰西海战中击败了法国军队.
te: British forces defeat French forces in the last naval battle in New France.
dz: 英国军队在最后一场新法兰西海战中击败了法国军队.
de: British forces defeat French forces in the last naval battle in New France.

t: 利格尼茨战役：腓特烈大帝战胜恩斯特·吉迪恩·冯·劳登领导下的奥地利人。
te: Battle of Liegnitz: Frederick the Great's victory over the Austrians under Ernst Gideon von Laudon.
dz: 七年战争：利格尼茨战役：腓特烈大帝战胜恩斯特·吉迪恩·冯·劳登领导下的奥地利人。
de: Seven Years' War: Battle of Liegnitz: Frederick the Great's victory over the Austrians under Ernst Gideon von Laudon.

t: 法国向英国人投降蒙特利尔,完成后者对新法兰西的征服.
te: French surrender Montreal to the British, completing the latter's conquest of New France.
dz: 法印战争:法国向英国人投降蒙特利尔,完成后者对新法兰西的征服.
de: French and Indian War: French surrender Montreal to the British, completing the latter's conquest of New France.

t: 俄罗斯和奥地利军队短暂占领柏林。
te: Russian and Austrian troops briefly occupy Berlin.
dz: 七年战争：俄罗斯和奥地利军队短暂占领柏林。
de: Seven Years' War: Russian and Austrian troops briefly occupy Berlin.

t: 在与荷兰殖民当局签订的条约中,苏里南的恩德乌卡人从逃出后所生的奴隶中获得了领土自治权.
te: In a treaty with the Dutch colonial authorities, the Ndyuka people of Suriname – descended from escaped slaves – gain t…
dz: 在与荷兰殖民当局签订的条约中,苏里南的恩德乌卡人从逃出后所生的奴隶中获得了领土自治权.
de: In a treaty with the Dutch colonial authorities, the Ndyuka people of Suriname – descended from escaped slaves – gain territorial autonomy.

t: 乔治三世国王在其祖父乔治二世去世后继承英国王位。
te: King George III succeeds to the British throne on the death of his grandfather George II.
dz: 乔治三世国王在其祖父乔治二世去世后继承英国王位。
de: King George III succeeds to the British throne on the death of his grandfather George II.

t: 瓦莱塔第二所建造的Castellania在内部的Sorrows礼拜堂的祝福下正式落成.
te: The secondly-built Castellania in Valletta is officially inaugurated with the blessing of the interior Chapel of Sorrow…
dz: 瓦莱塔第二所建造的Castellania在内部的Sorrows礼拜堂的祝福下正式落成.
de: The secondly-built Castellania in Valletta is officially inaugurated with the blessing of the interior Chapel of Sorrows.

t: 在瓦莱塔的Castellania重建的债务人监狱接收了第一批囚犯.
te: The rebuilt debtors' prison, at the Castellania in Valletta, receives the first prisoners.
dz: 在瓦莱塔的Castellania重建的债务人监狱接收了第一批囚犯.
de: The rebuilt debtors' prison, at the Castellania in Valletta, receives the first prisoners.
